beal-opera-8-5-mm: Thin, light rope for multipitch and ice, though a few find the sheath fuzzes easily.
black-diamond-aspect-pro: All-day crack and multipitch shoe that fits better than the TC Pro; a couple saw delamination.
black-diamond-atc-pilot: Smooth feeding and lowering with a tube-like feel, good value; a few note slippage on some ropes.
black-diamond-solution-guide-harness: Roomy enough for a big trad rack, but a couple saw it wear out within one to two years.
black-diamond-solution-harness: Wide leg loops that are easy to forget about; the fixed loops need careful sizing for big thighs.
butora-gomi: Sticky with a secure heel for wide forefeet, but toes can feel cramped and it is soft for edging.
butora-rubicon: Very comfortable and medium-soft, smearing well on slab; one finds it poor on steep overhangs.
edelrid-autana: Adjustable leg loops and thick padding suit large thighs; the main gripe is tiny gear loops.
edelrid-giga-jul: Assisted braking, guide mode and rappels in one device, though many find feeding rope grabby.
edelrid-mega-jul: Light, simple and durable for single-pitch lead; guide mode takes effort and rappels are jerky.
edelrid-ohm: Keeps the belayer from being yanked up when belaying a much heavier climber, but catches are hard.
edelrid-ohmega: Smoother, softer catches than the Ohm for a much heavier climber; some struggle with the settings.
edelrid-pinch: Smooth belaying that clips straight to the belay loop; drags on thick gym ropes, awkward racking.
evolv-defy-lace: Comfortable, good-value shoe that is not too aggressive for warm-ups; one found it too tight.
evolv-kira: Very comfortable, lightly downturned shoe for a first or all-day pair; too soft for micro edges.
evolv-kronos: A first or second pair for wide, Egyptian-shaped feet; heel fit is mixed, baggy for a few.
evolv-zenist: Very soft and sensitive with a roomy toe box for indoor bouldering; too soft for long days on edges.
la-sportiva-kubo: A good step up from beginner shoes once broken in; many report a painful first few sessions.
la-sportiva-skwama: Roomy toe box and good heel hooks for wide feet; soft rubber and heel seams wear out within months.
misty-mountain-cadillac: Plush trad and big wall harness with double buckles and many gear loops; some say it is heavy.
organic-big-pad: Large, stiff and durable enough to trust for solo bouldering; heavy and bulky on long approaches.
petzl-aquila: Five gear loops and adjustable leg loops for trad and multipitch; one finds it pinchy on the hips.
petzl-corax: Two waist buckles suit pear shapes and big hips or thighs; some find it uncomfortable when hanging.
petzl-luna: Padded and adjustable for a small waist with big thighs; gear loops suit sport better than trad.
petzl-neox: Pays out rope for lead belaying close to a tube device; it can lock up on thick ropes.
petzl-selena: Comfortable for sport and gym, including on wider thighs, though a few had off-centre gear loops.
petzl-sitta: Light and packs small, with room for much of a trad rack; comfort when hanging is mixed.
scarpa-drago: Soft, sensitive and sticky for indoor bouldering; holes often appear at the toes within months.
scarpa-drago-lv: Snug narrow heel for low-volume feet and a soft feel; many report a painful break-in.
scarpa-helix: Comfortable neutral lace-up for beginners that lasts well; a few find it limited on tiny holds.
scarpa-instinct-vsr: Versatile all-rounder with good edging and a wide toe box; many describe a painful break-in.
scarpa-instinct-vsr-lv: Snug heel for hooking on narrow or shallow heels; some have a tough break-in.
scarpa-mago: Strong toe power and a great heel for steep rock; tight and painful during break-in.
scarpa-veloce: Soft, sticky gym favourite for wide feet; it wears out quickly and many find the heel baggy.
scarpa-veloce-l: Very sticky lace-up that smears well for warm-ups; the heel bags out, so several size down.
tenaya-indalo: Comfortable for a performance shoe with good edging and toe hooks; many go well below street size.
tenaya-mastia: Fits wide feet and low-volume heels, stiff for edging yet sensitive; some wish it lasted longer.
tenaya-ra: Comfortable enough to wear through a whole session and edges well; a few wore holes in the toes.
